You can't escape your violent past, especially when a ruthless bounty hunter is on your trail! Synopsis:
Clint (George Martin) is a former gunslinger trying to outrun his dark reputation. Exhausted by a life of violence, he returns to his hometown after years of absence, hoping to make amends with his estranged wife and children. Determined to hang up his guns forever, Clint tries to settle down as a peaceful farmer. However, the West is an unforgiving place. A ruthless land baron and his gang of outlaws are terrorizing the local ranchers, trying to steal their properties. To make matters worse, a deadly and calculating bounty hunter named Scott (Klaus Kinski) arrives in town, waiting for the perfect moment to collect a massive reward on Clint's head. When the bandits push his family too far and the law turns a blind eye, Clint realizes that peace is no longer an option. He must strap on his gun belt one last time to protect the people he loves in a final, explosive showdown.

recentItems.title: A Young Terence Hill in a Musical Western! | LITTLE RITA NEL WEST
recentItems.description:
Watch the full movie "Crazy Westerners" (also known as "Rita of the West"), an incredible and unique musical comedy with a stellar cast: Italian pop superstar Rita Pavone, a young Terence Hill before his "Trinity" fame, and the legendary Lucio Dalla. In this bizarre Spaghetti Western, the small but fierce Rita is a gunslinger with a very peculiar mission: she isn't seeking wealth, but wants to eliminate all gold from the world, convinced that it is the root of all evil. She travels the Far West, defeats gangs of outlaws, takes their gold, and accumulates it in a secret cave, with the intention of blowing it all up to purify the world.

Her path inevitably crosses with strange and dangerous characters, including the charming outlaw Black Star (Terence Hill), a quirky Native American chief (Lucio Dalla), and many others. Between duels, comedic brawls, and surreal situations, the story is punctuated by unforgettable songs performed by Rita Pavone herself. This is a true cult classic that explosively mixes the Italian "musicarello" with the western parody, directed by Ferdinando Baldi.
